neighbours.label: the subject's head noun or name at the start of a definitional sentence ('The X is a ...'), just before the definition
fire: Origin and History. The walnut tree is a large deciduous plant native to Persia.
Overview. The snow leopard is a big cat that lives in the mountains of Central Asia.
Biography. Lucas Moreau is a French chef known for his seafood restaurants.
The giant panda is a bear species endemic to China.
Description. The cork oak is an evergreen tree that grows in Portugal and Spain.
Profile. Ingrid Halvorsen is a Norwegian sculptor who works mainly in bronze.
The Danube is the second-longest river in Europe.
Introduction. The red fox is the largest of the true foxes.
quiet: Last weekend we sat under the walnut tree and ate our sandwiches.
On the trek we saw tracks that our guide said were from a snow leopard.
We booked a table at the restaurant that Lucas Moreau opened last year.
The children laughed when the giant panda rolled over in the snow.
Our neighbour cut down the cork oak because it blocked the sunlight.
At the gallery opening I shook hands with Ingrid Halvorsen briefly.
We took a slow boat trip along the Danube during our holiday.
Last night a red fox knocked over our rubbish bin again.

notes: Top examples end a subject NP that is then defined (Guinea Flower, is said..., The cherry tree is a..., Alexandra Evans is an English model). Probe: definitional subjects 0.1-0.6, same nouns in narrative 0.05.
